_help: Copy this folder to trips/<id>/ and fill it in. Keys starting with _ are ignored. SAC grades: T1 easy trail, T2 mountain trail, T3 demanding mountain trail, T4 alpine route (scrambling/exposure), T5–T6 alpine. Hazards: exposure, scramble, glacier, tyrolean, packraft, ford, ford-deep, navigation, steep-loose, snow, boat, guided, private-land. Airports in tools/places.py: PMC, BBA, PUQ, PNT, FTE, BRC, USH, EQS.
title: Patagonia hiking plans
lede: One paragraph describing what these plans are for (shown on the overview page).

budget.covers: food, fuel, campgrounds, park fees, ferries (not flights or the car)

arrival_note: How the first and last day work (flights, pickup, drop-off).
